install_steps: Or download toxiproxy-cli + toxiproxy-server binaries from https://github.com/Shopify/toxiproxy/releases
Or: docker pull ghcr.io/shopify/toxiproxy (server in container)
Start the daemon first: toxiproxy-server (listens on :8474)
note: Two binaries: `toxiproxy-server` (the daemon, HTTP API on :8474) and `toxiproxy-cli` (the client). Proxies can also be declared in a JSON config file passed to `toxiproxy-server -config`. For remote servers use `toxiproxy-cli --host http://host:8474`. HTTP API is open — don't expose :8474 publicly.
